content:
DomeCtrl’s ControlBox is a Raspberry Pi 5-based controller running Home Assistant and primarily designed for hydronic radiant floor heating (RFH) systems. It also supports lighting solutions and integration with energy devices such as solar collectors, photovoltaic installations, heat pumps, hydraulic pumps & valves. The system controls thermal valves, hydraulic PWM pumps, and related RFH devices, and can read multiple 1-wire temperature sensors over long cables (>6 m).  The ControlBox also features 32 LED-strip output channels, for up to 2 kW output. ControlBox specifications: Main board – Raspberry Pi 5 SBC with 4GB RAM Storage – 128GB NVMe SSD pre-loaded with Home Assistant Wired Communication Gigabit Ethernet on SBC Half-duplex RS485 communication bus (5 V) Wireless WiFi 5 and Bluetooth 5 on SBC W32-ESP01 header for control via ESPHome 433 MHz transmitter & receiver modules for communication with wireless peripherals like ‘ClickOnClickOff’, curtain rails, screens, garage doors, etc. I/Os via terminal [...]
